design.workflow: Real application design, actual browser screenshots, direct human functional/pedagogical/visual review, iterative correction, approval before merge. No Figma dependency or handoff.
design.implementation: Explicit geography-evidence activity layout; scoped table/grid/type/preview CSS; existing shared rendering, source inspection, navigation and export reused. Temporary teal retained.
design.difference: Full reading-width table, readable non-compacted numeric columns, larger authentic map preview and a responsive map/task arrangement.
design.boundaries: No new engine, answer workflow, colour theme or subject-wide redesign. Existing lessons do not opt in. Global image caps and accepted G03/Mathematics/History sources unchanged.

dot.status: Future opportunities only; no Dot dependency or modification
opportunities: Use Dot’s approved application to inspect the same dated population evidence at multiple scales, preserving source/legend/units and linked task context.
Compare a population layer with dated transport, employment or environmental evidence to test a proposed mechanism; do not infer causation from overlay alone.
If a future tool supports change, distinguish comparable dates/classifications from a single density snapshot.
dot.integrationGate: Verify actual application capabilities, embedding/security/accessibility, data rights and teaching benefit before a new bounded task. No new GIS or map engine here.

blockers: Human pedagogical and visual approval of this actual candidate.
School-adopted syllabus and formal curriculum mapping must be confirmed before claiming alignment.
Separate explicit lesson-publication approval; no release date or corresponding video publication is authorised.
limitations: Paper responses are not automatically captured or marked; teacher-led feedback is required.

Generic standalone Geography questions are not indexed by the present practice-collection Answer Hub. Candidate final/worked policies are hidden, models are in the separate teacher guide, and all six answer keys are stripped from the standalone learner. No automatic completion reveal is promised.
Map is a reduced, adapted static official modelled grid: suitable for broad patterns, not exact household/cell measurements.
A dated release is deliberately used for internally consistent evidence, not latest population figures.
No physical-device, screen-reader or remote classroom-service certification; no observed classroom timing evidence.
No new smartphone development or polish.
